export async function updateUserCourseSelection(
  uid: string,
  selectionOrQualification:
    | UserCourseSelection
    | string,
  examBoard?: string,
  currentCourse?: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const cleanedUid =
    uid.trim();

  if (!cleanedUid) {
    throw new Error(
      "A valid user ID is required.",
    );
  }

  /*
   * Prevent a pending teacher applicant from accidentally
   * completing student curriculum onboarding.
   */
  const existingProfile =
    await getUserProfile(
      cleanedUid,
    );

  if (
    existingProfile?.accountIntent ===
      "teacher" &&
    existingProfile.role ===
      "student"
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Teacher applicants do not need to select a student curriculum.",
    );
  }

  const selection =
    typeof selectionOrQualification ===
    "string"
      ? {
          qualification:
            selectionOrQualification,

          examBoard:
            examBoard || "",

          currentCourse:
            currentCourse || "",
        }
      : selectionOrQualification;

  const cleanedQualification =
    selection.qualification.trim();

  const cleanedExamBoard =
    selection.examBoard.trim();

  const cleanedCurrentCourse =
    selection.currentCourse?.trim() ||
    "";

  if (
    cleanedQualification !==
      "GCSE" &&
    cleanedQualification !==
      "A_LEVEL"
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Select either GCSE or A-level.",
    );
  }

  if (
    cleanedExamBoard !== "AQA" &&
    cleanedExamBoard !== "OCR" &&
    cleanedExamBoard !== "EDEXCEL"
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Select AQA, OCR or Pearson Edexcel.",
    );
  }

  const updateData: Record<
    string,
    unknown
  > = {
    qualification:
      cleanedQualification,

    examBoard:
      cleanedExamBoard,

    onboardingComplete: true,

    updatedAt:
      serverTimestamp(),
  };

  if (cleanedCurrentCourse) {
    updateData.currentCourse =
      cleanedCurrentCourse;
  }

  await updateDoc(
    doc(
      db,
      "users",
      cleanedUid,
    ),
    updateData,
  );
}

export async function ensureUserProfile(
  firebaseUser: User,
): Promise<UserProfile> {
  const reference = doc(
    db,
    "users",
    firebaseUser.uid,
  );

  const snapshot =
    await getDoc(reference);

  const authenticationEmail =
    normaliseEmail(
      firebaseUser.email,
    );

  const authenticationName =
    normaliseString(
      firebaseUser.displayName,
    );

  if (!snapshot.exists()) {
    const fallbackName =
      authenticationName ||
      inferNameFromEmail(
        authenticationEmail,
      );

    await createUserProfile({
      uid: firebaseUser.uid,
      name: fallbackName,
      email: authenticationEmail,
      role: "student",
      accountIntent: "student",
    });

    const createdSnapshot =
      await getDoc(reference);

    if (!createdSnapshot.exists()) {
      throw new Error(
        "The user profile could not be created.",
      );
    }

    return convertUserProfile(
      createdSnapshot.id,
      createdSnapshot.data() as Partial<FirestoreUserProfile>,
    );
  }

  const existing =
    snapshot.data() as Partial<FirestoreUserProfile>;

  const existingRole =
    isUserRole(existing.role)
      ? existing.role
      : "student";

  const existingIntent =
    normaliseAccountIntent(
      existing.accountIntent,
      existingRole,
    );

  const existingStatus =
    normaliseTeacherAccessStatus(
      existing.teacherAccessStatus,
      existingRole,
      existingIntent,
    );

  const existingEmail =
    normaliseEmail(
      existing.email,
    );

  const existingName =
    normaliseString(
      existing.name,
    );

  const repairedEmail =
    existingEmail ||
    authenticationEmail;

  const repairedName =
    existingName ||
    authenticationName ||
    inferNameFromEmail(
      repairedEmail,
    );

  const repairData: Record<
    string,
    unknown
  > = {};

  if (
    normaliseString(
      existing.uid,
    ) !== firebaseUser.uid
  ) {
    repairData.uid =
      firebaseUser.uid;
  }

  if (!existingName) {
    repairData.name =
      repairedName;
  }

  if (!existingEmail) {
    repairData.email =
      repairedEmail;
  }

  if (
    !isUserRole(
      existing.role,
    )
  ) {
    repairData.role =
      "student";
  }

  if (
    existing.accountIntent !==
      "student" &&
    existing.accountIntent !==
      "teacher"
  ) {
    repairData.accountIntent =
      existingIntent;
  }

  if (
    existing.teacherAccessStatus !==
      "not_submitted" &&
    existing.teacherAccessStatus !==
      "pending" &&
    existing.teacherAccessStatus !==
      "approved" &&
    existing.teacherAccessStatus !==
      "rejected"
  ) {
    repairData.teacherAccessStatus =
      existingStatus || null;
  }

  const existingSchoolId =
    normaliseString(
      existing.schoolId,
    );

  const resolvedAccountType =
    normaliseAccountType(
      existing.accountType,
      existingSchoolId,
    );

  const resolvedPersonalPlan =
    normalisePersonalPlan(
      existing.personalPlan,
    );

  const resolvedPlan =
    normalisePlan(
      existing.plan,
      resolvedAccountType,
      resolvedPersonalPlan,
    );

  if (
    existing.schoolId ===
    undefined
  ) {
    repairData.schoolId = null;
  }

  if (
    existing.accountType !== "individual" &&
    existing.accountType !== "school"
  ) {
    repairData.accountType =
      resolvedAccountType;
  }

  if (
    existing.personalPlan !== "free" &&
    existing.personalPlan !== "premium"
  ) {
    repairData.personalPlan =
      resolvedPersonalPlan;
  }

  if (
    existing.plan !== "free" &&
    existing.plan !== "premium" &&
    existing.plan !== "school"
  ) {
    repairData.plan =
      resolvedPlan;
  }

  if (
    !Array.isArray(
      existing.classIds,
    )
  ) {
    repairData.classIds = [];
  }

  if (
    existing.qualification ===
    undefined
  ) {
    repairData.qualification =
      null;
  }

  if (
    existing.examBoard ===
    undefined
  ) {
    repairData.examBoard =
      null;
  }

  if (
    typeof existing.currentCourse !==
    "string"
  ) {
    repairData.currentCourse =
      "";
  }

  if (
    typeof existing.onboardingComplete !==
    "boolean"
  ) {
    const hasCourse =
      Boolean(
        normaliseString(
          existing.qualification,
        ),
      ) &&
      Boolean(
        normaliseString(
          existing.examBoard,
        ),
      );

    repairData.onboardingComplete =
      existingRole === "teacher" ||
      existingRole === "admin" ||
      hasCourse;
  }

  if (
    typeof existing.xp !==
    "number"
  ) {
    repairData.xp = 0;
  }

  if (
    typeof existing.streak !==
    "number"
  ) {
    repairData.streak = 0;
  }

  if (
    !Array.isArray(
      existing.completedLessons,
    )
  ) {
    repairData.completedLessons =
      [];
  }

  if (
    !Array.isArray(
      existing.completedTopics,
    )
  ) {
    repairData.completedTopics =
      [];
  }

  if (
    !Array.isArray(
      existing.completedUnits,
    )
  ) {
    repairData.completedUnits =
      [];
  }

  if (
    !Array.isArray(
      existing.completedPapers,
    )
  ) {
    repairData.completedPapers =
      [];
  }

  if (
    !Array.isArray(
      existing.badges,
    )
  ) {
    repairData.badges = [];
  }

  if (
    Object.keys(
      repairData,
    ).length > 0
  ) {
    await setDoc(
      reference,
      {
        ...repairData,

        updatedAt:
          serverTimestamp(),
      },
      {
        merge: true,
      },
    );
  }

  return convertUserProfile(
    snapshot.id,
    {
      ...existing,
      ...repairData,
    },
  );
}

export async function updatePersonalPlan(
  uid: string,
  personalPlan: PersonalPlan,
): Promise<void> {
  const cleanedUid = uid.trim();

  if (!cleanedUid) {
    throw new Error("A valid user account is required.");
  }

  const profile = await getUserProfile(cleanedUid);

  if (!profile) {
    throw new Error("The user profile could not be found.");
  }

  await updateDoc(
    doc(db, "users", cleanedUid),
    {
      personalPlan,
      plan:
        profile.accountType === "school"
          ? "school"
          : personalPlan,
      updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
    },
  );
}

export async function getUserProfile(
  uid: string,
): Promise<UserProfile | null> {
  const cleanedUid =
    uid.trim();

  if (!cleanedUid) {
    return null;
  }

  const snapshot =
    await getDoc(
      doc(
        db,
        "users",
        cleanedUid,
      ),
    );

  if (!snapshot.exists()) {
    return null;
  }

  return convertUserProfile(
    snapshot.id,
    snapshot.data() as Partial<FirestoreUserProfile>,
  );
}

  | "not_started"
  | "in_progress"
  | "submitted"
  | "marking"
  | "marked";

export type ExamVisibilityAction =
  | "warn"
  | "pause"
  | "auto_submit";

export type ExamIntegrityIncidentType =
  | "fullscreen_exit"
  | "fullscreen_restored"
  | "page_hidden"
  | "page_visible"
  | "integrity_termination";

export type ExamIntegrityPolicy = {
  enabled: boolean;

  /*
   * CS Master integrity monitoring is not a secure lockdown browser.
   * Fullscreen is used as a visible exam-state control only.
   */
  fullscreenRequired: boolean;

  /*
   * Product rule: leaving fullscreen starts a visible five-second
   * countdown. If fullscreen is not restored, the exam is terminated
   * and submitted automatically.
   */
  fullscreenExitCountdownSeconds: 5;

  /*
   * Teacher-configurable response to document visibility changes.
   */
  visibilityAction: ExamVisibilityAction;
  monitorPageVisibility: boolean;
};

export const DEFAULT_EXAM_INTEGRITY_POLICY: ExamIntegrityPolicy = {
  enabled: true,
  fullscreenRequired: true,
  fullscreenExitCountdownSeconds: 5,
  visibilityAction: "warn",
  monitorPageVisibility: true,
};

FILE: utils\export\wordExport.ts

import {
  AlignmentType,
  BorderStyle,
  Document,
  Footer,
  HeadingLevel,
  Packer,
  PageBreak,
  Paragraph,
  ShadingType,
  Table,
  TableCell,
  TableRow,
  TextRun,
  WidthType,
} from "docx";

import { saveAs } from "file-saver";

import type { SavedTeacherResource } from "@/services/teacherResourceService";

const BRAND_COLOUR = "4F46E5";
const BRAND_DARK = "312E81";
const LIGHT_INDIGO = "EEF2FF";
const LIGHT_SLATE = "F8FAFC";
const BORDER_COLOUR = "CBD5E1";
const TEXT_COLOUR = "1E293B";
const MUTED_TEXT = "64748B";
const SUCCESS_COLOUR = "047857";
const WARNING_BACKGROUND = "FFFBEB";

function safeText(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  const cleanedValue = value?.trim();

  return cleanedValue || "Not provided";
}

function sanitiseFileName(value: string): string {
  const cleanedValue = value
    .trim()
    .replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*\u0000-\u001F]/g, "")
    .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
    .replace(/-+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, "");

  return cleanedValue || "cs-master-resource";
}

function formatResourceType(value: string): string {
  return value
    .replace(/[-_]/g, " ")
    .replace(/\b\w/g, (character) => character.toUpperCase());
}

function formatStatus(value: string): string {
  return value
    .replace(/[-_]/g, " ")
    .replace(/\b\w/g, (character) => character.toUpperCase());
}

function formatExportDate(): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "long",
    year: "numeric",
  }).format(new Date());
}

function createSectionHeading(title: string): Paragraph {
  return new Paragraph({
    heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_1,
    spacing: {
      before: 360,
      after: 180,
    },
    border: {
      bottom: {
        style: BorderStyle.SINGLE,
        size: 10,
        color: BRAND_COLOUR,
        space: 6,
      },
    },
    children: [
      new TextRun({
        text: title,
        bold: true,
        color: BRAND_DARK,
        size: 30,
      }),
    ],
  });
}

function createSubheading(title: string): Paragraph {
  return new Paragraph({
    heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_2,
    spacing: {
      before: 240,
      after: 100,
    },
    children: [
      new TextRun({
        text: title,
        bold: true,
        color: TEXT_COLOUR,
        size: 25,
      }),
    ],
  });
}

function createBodyParagraph(
  text: string,
  options?: {
    bold?: boolean;
    italic?: boolean;
    colour?: string;
    before?: number;
    after?: number;
  },
): Paragraph {
  return new Paragraph({
    spacing: {
      before: options?.before ?? 0,
      after: options?.after ?? 140,
      line: 300,
    },
    children: [
      new TextRun({
        text: safeText(text),
        bold: options?.bold,
        italics: options?.italic,
        color: options?.colour ?? TEXT_COLOUR,
        size: 22,
      }),
    ],
  });
}

function createBulletParagraph(text: string): Paragraph {
  return new Paragraph({
    bullet: {
      level: 0,
    },
    spacing: {
      after: 90,
      line: 280,
    },
    children: [
      new TextRun({
        text: safeText(text),
        color: TEXT_COLOUR,
        size: 22,
      }),
    ],
  });
}

function createNumberedQuestion(
  number: number,
  question: string,
  marks: number,
): Paragraph {
  return new Paragraph({
    spacing: {
      before: 180,
      after: 100,
      line: 300,
    },
    children: [
      new TextRun({
        text: `${number}. `,
        bold: true,
        color: BRAND_COLOUR,
        size: 22,
      }),

      new TextRun({
        text: safeText(question),
        bold: true,
        color: TEXT_COLOUR,
        size: 22,
      }),

      new TextRun({
        text: `  [${marks} ${marks === 1 ? "mark" : "marks"}]`,
        bold: true,
        color: MUTED_TEXT,
        size: 20,
      }),
    ],
  });
}

function createDetailRow(label: string, value: string): TableRow {
  return new TableRow({

          size: 32,
          type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE,
        },
        shading: {
          type: ShadingType.CLEAR,
          fill: LIGHT_INDIGO,
        },
        margins: {
          top: 130,
          bottom: 130,
          left: 160,
          right: 160,
        },
        children: [
          new Paragraph({
            children: [
              new TextRun({
                text: label,
                bold: true,
                color: BRAND_DARK,
                size: 21,
              }),
            ],
          }),
        ],
      }),

      new TableCell({
        width: {
          size: 68,
          type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE,
        },
        margins: {
          top: 130,
          bottom: 130,
          left: 160,
          right: 160,
        },
        children: [
          new Paragraph({
            children: [
              new TextRun({
                text: safeText(value),
                color: TEXT_COLOUR,
                size: 21,
              }),
            ],
          }),
        ],
      }),
    ],
  });
}

function createLessonSectionTable(
  sectionNumber: number,
  section: SavedTeacherResource["content"]["sections"][number],
): Table {
  const titleCell = new TableCell({
    columnSpan: 2,

      type: ShadingType.CLEAR,

            text: `${sectionNumber}. ${safeText(section.title)}`,

          }),

          new TextRun({
            text: ` â€” ${safeText(section.duration)}`,

  function createContentRow(label: string, value: string): TableRow {

                new TextRun({
                  text: label,
                  bold: true,
                  color: BRAND_DARK,
                  size: 20,
                }),
              ],
            }),
          ],
        }),

        new TableCell({
          width: {
            size: 73,
            type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE,
          },
          margins: {
            top: 140,
            bottom: 140,
            left: 150,
            right: 150,
          },

            new Paragraph({
              spacing: {
                line: 280,
              },

                new TextRun({
                  text: safeText(value),
                  color: TEXT_COLOUR,
                  size: 20,
                }),
              ],
            }),
          ],
        }),
      ],
    });
  }

  const resources =
    section.resources.length > 0
      ? section.resources.join("\nâ€¢ ")
      : "No additional resources required";

  return new Table({
    width: {
      size: 100,
      type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE,
    },
    borders: {
      top: {
        style: BorderStyle.SINGLE,
        size: 4,
        color: BORDER_COLOUR,
      },

        style: BorderStyle.SINGLE,

        color: BORDER_COLOUR,

        style: BorderStyle.SINGLE,

        color: BORDER_COLOUR,
      },
      right: {
        style: BorderStyle.SINGLE,
        size: 4,
        color: BORDER_COLOUR,
      },
      insideHorizontal: {
        style: BorderStyle.SINGLE,
        size: 4,
        color: BORDER_COLOUR,
      },
      insideVertical: {
        style: BorderStyle.SINGLE,

        color: BORDER_COLOUR,

      createContentRow("Student activity", section.studentTask),
      createContentRow("Assessment", section.assessment),

function createDifferentiationTable(resource: SavedTeacherResource): Table {
  const differentiation = resource.content.differentiation;

  function createColumn(title: string, items: string[]): TableCell {
    return new TableCell({
      width: {
        size: 33.33,
        type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE,
      },
      margins: {
        top: 150,
        bottom: 150,
        left: 150,
        right: 150,
      },
      children: [
        new Paragraph({
          spacing: {
            after: 120,
          },
          children: [
            new TextRun({
              text: title,
              bold: true,
              color: BRAND_DARK,
              size: 22,
            }),
          ],
        }),

        ...(items.length > 0
          ? items.map((item) => createBulletParagraph(item))
          : [
              createBodyParagraph("No strategies provided.", {
                italic: true,
                colour: MUTED_TEXT,
              }),
            ]),
      ],
    });
  }

  return new Table({
    width: {
      size: 100,
      type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE,
    },
    borders: {
      top: {
        style: BorderStyle.SINGLE,
        size: 4,
        color: BORDER_COLOUR,
      },
      bottom: {
        style: BorderStyle.SINGLE,
        size: 4,
        color: BORDER_COLOUR,
      },
      left: {
        style: BorderStyle.SINGLE,
        size: 4,
        color: BORDER_COLOUR,
      },
      right: {
        style: BorderStyle.SINGLE,
        size: 4,
        color: BORDER_COLOUR,
      },
      insideHorizontal: {
        style: BorderStyle.SINGLE,
        size: 4,
        color: BORDER_COLOUR,
      },
      insideVertical: {
        style: BorderStyle.SINGLE,
        size: 4,
        color: BORDER_COLOUR,
      },
    },
    rows: [
      new TableRow({
        children: [
          createColumn("Support", differentiation.support),
          createColumn("Core", differentiation.core),
          createColumn("Stretch", differentiation.stretch),
        ],
      }),
    ],
  });
}

function createCoverContent(resource: SavedTeacherResource): Paragraph[] {
  return [
    new Paragraph({
      alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
      spacing: {
        before: 500,
        after: 140,
      },
      children: [
        new TextRun({
          text: "CS MASTER",
          bold: true,
          color: BRAND_COLOUR,
          size: 44,
          characterSpacing: 80,
        }),
      ],
    }),

    new Paragraph({
      alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
      spacing: {
        after: 500,
      },
      children: [
        new TextRun({
          text: "TEACHING RESOURCE",
          bold: true,
          color: MUTED_TEXT,
          size: 24,
          characterSpacing: 40,
        }),
      ],
    }),

    new Paragraph({
      alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
      spacing: {
        before: 300,
        after: 240,
      },
      children: [
        new TextRun({
          text: safeText(resource.title),
          bold: true,
          color: BRAND_DARK,
          size: 40,
        }),
      ],
    }),

    new Paragraph({
      alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
      spacing: {
        after: 500,
      },
      children: [
        new TextRun({
          text: safeText(resource.content.overview),
          color: TEXT_COLOUR,
          size: 23,
          italics: true,
        }),
      ],
    }),
  ];
}

function createFooter(): Footer {
  return new Footer({

        children: [
          new TextRun({
            text: "Generated by CS Master",
            bold: true,
            color: BRAND_COLOUR,
            size: 18,
          }),

          new TextRun({
            text: `  â€¢  ${formatExportDate()}`,
            color: MUTED_TEXT,
            size: 18,
          }),
        ],
      }),
    ],
  });
}

export async function exportResourceToWord(
  resource: SavedTeacherResource,
): Promise<void> {
  const content = resource.content;

  const documentChildren: (Paragraph | Table)[] = [
    ...createCoverContent(resource),

    createDetailsTable(resource),

    new Paragraph({
      children: [new PageBreak()],
    }),

    createSectionHeading("Resource Overview"),

    createBodyParagraph(content.overview),

    createSectionHeading("Learning Objectives"),

    ...(content.learningObjectives.length > 0
      ? content.learningObjectives.map(createBulletParagraph)
      : [
          createBodyParagraph("No learning objectives provided.", {
            italic: true,
            colour: MUTED_TEXT,
          }),
        ]),

    createSectionHeading("Success Criteria"),

    ...(content.successCriteria.length > 0
      ? content.successCriteria.map(createBulletParagraph)
      : [
          createBodyParagraph("No success criteria provided.", {
            italic: true,
            colour: MUTED_TEXT,
          }),
        ]),

    createSectionHeading("Prior Knowledge"),

    ...(content.priorKnowledge.length > 0
      ? content.priorKnowledge.map(createBulletParagraph)
      : [
          createBodyParagraph("No specific prior knowledge required.", {
            italic: true,
            colour: MUTED_TEXT,
          }),
        ]),

    createSectionHeading("Keywords"),

    createBodyParagraph(
      content.keywords.length > 0
        ? content.keywords.join(", ")
        : "No keywords provided.",
    ),

    createSectionHeading("Lesson Sequence"),
  ];

  content.sections.forEach((section, index) => {
    documentChildren.push(createLessonSectionTable(index + 1, section));

    documentChildren.push(
      new Paragraph({
        spacing: {
          after: 260,
        },
        children: [],
      }),
    );
  });

  documentChildren.push(
    createSectionHeading("Differentiation"),

    createDifferentiationTable(resource),

    createSectionHeading("Common Misconceptions"),
  );

  if (content.misconceptions.length > 0) {
    content.misconceptions.forEach((item, index) => {
      documentChildren.push(
        createSubheading(`Misconception ${index + 1}`),

        createBodyParagraph(item.misconception, {
          bold: true,
          colour: "92400E",
        }),

        createBodyParagraph(`Correction: ${safeText(item.correction)}`, {
          colour: SUCCESS_COLOUR,
        }),
      );
    });
  } else {
    documentChildren.push(
      createBodyParagraph("No common misconceptions provided.", {
        italic: true,
        colour: MUTED_TEXT,
      }),
    );
  }

  documentChildren.push(createSectionHeading("Assessment Questions"));

  if (content.assessmentQuestions.length > 0) {
    content.assessmentQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
      documentChildren.push(
        createNumberedQuestion(index + 1, question.question, question.marks),

        new Paragraph({
          shading: {
            type: ShadingType.CLEAR,
            fill: WARNING_BACKGROUND,
          },
          spacing: {
            before: 60,
            after: 180,
            line: 280,
          },
          indent: {
            left: 240,
            right: 240,
          },
          children: [
            new TextRun({
              text: "Model answer: ",
              bold: true,
              color: SUCCESS_COLOUR,
              size: 20,
            }),

            new TextRun({
              text: safeText(question.answer),
              color: TEXT_COLOUR,
              size: 20,
            }),
          ],
        }),
      );
    });
  } else {
    documentChildren.push(
      createBodyParagraph("No assessment questions provided.", {
        italic: true,
        colour: MUTED_TEXT,
      }),
    );
  }

  documentChildren.push(
    createSectionHeading("Homework"),

    createBodyParagraph(content.homework),

    createSectionHeading("Teacher Notes"),

    createBodyParagraph(content.teacherNotes),

    new Paragraph({
      alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
      spacing: {
        before: 500,
      },
      children: [
        new TextRun({
          text: "End of resource",
          bold: true,
          color: BRAND_COLOUR,
          size: 20,
        }),
      ],
    }),
  );

  const wordDocument = new Document({
    creator: "CS Master",
    title: resource.title,
    subject: resource.topic,
    description: "Teaching resource exported from CS Master",
    keywords: content.keywords.join(", "),
    sections: [
      {
        properties: {
          page: {
            margin: {
              top: 900,
              right: 900,
              bottom: 900,
              left: 900,
            },
          },
        },
        footers: {
          default: createFooter(),
        },
        children: documentChildren,
      },
    ],
  });

  const documentBlob = await Packer.toBlob(wordDocument);

  const fileName = `${sanitiseFileName(resource.title)}-CS-Master.docx`;

  saveAs(documentBlob, fileName);
}

rules_version = '2';

service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Shared helper functions
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    function signedIn() {
      return request.auth != null;
    }

    function currentUserId() {
      return request.auth.uid;
    }

    function userProfileExists() {
      return signedIn() &&
        exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(currentUserId())
        );
    }

    function currentUserProfile() {
      return get(
        /databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(currentUserId())
      ).data;
    }

    function isTeacher() {
      return userProfileExists() &&
        (
          currentUserProfile().role == "teacher" ||
          currentUserProfile().role == "admin"
        );
    }

    function isAdmin() {
      return userProfileExists() &&
        currentUserProfile().role == "admin";
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // School / tenant helpers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    function currentUserHasSchool() {
      return userProfileExists() &&
        ("schoolId" in currentUserProfile()) &&
        currentUserProfile().schoolId is string &&
        currentUserProfile().schoolId != "";
    }

    function currentSchoolId() {
      return currentUserProfile().schoolId;
    }

    function schoolExists(schoolId) {
      return schoolId is string &&
        schoolId != "" &&
        exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/schools/$(schoolId)
        );
    }

    function schoolMemberExists(schoolId, userId) {
      return signedIn() &&
        schoolId is string &&
        schoolId != "" &&
        exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/schools/$(schoolId)/members/$(userId)
        );
    }

    function schoolMemberData(schoolId, userId) {
      return get(
        /databases/$(database)/documents/schools/$(schoolId)/members/$(userId)
      ).data;
    }

    function isSchoolMember(schoolId) {
      return schoolMemberExists(schoolId, currentUserId()) &&
        schoolMemberData(schoolId, currentUserId()).status == "active";
    }

    function isSchoolAdmin(schoolId) {
      return isAdmin() ||
        (
          isSchoolMember(schoolId) &&
          schoolMemberData(schoolId, currentUserId()).role == "school_admin"
        );
    }

    function isSchoolStaff(schoolId) {
      return isAdmin() ||
        (
          isSchoolMember(schoolId) &&
          schoolMemberData(schoolId, currentUserId()).role in [
            "teacher",
            "school_admin"
          ]
        );
    }

    function sameSchoolUser(userId) {
      return signedIn() &&
        currentUserHasSchool() &&
        exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(userId)
        ) &&
        get(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(userId)
        ).data.schoolId == currentSchoolId();
    }

    function validAccountType(data) {
      return !("accountType" in data) ||
        data.accountType == "individual" ||
        data.accountType == "school";
    }

    function validPersonalPlan(data) {
      return !("personalPlan" in data) ||
        data.personalPlan == "free" ||
        data.personalPlan == "premium";
    }

    function validEffectivePlan(data) {
      return !("plan" in data) ||
        data.plan == "free" ||
        data.plan == "premium" ||
        data.plan == "school";
    }

    function validSchoolIdField(data) {
      return !("schoolId" in data) ||
        data.schoolId == null ||
        data.schoolId is string;
    }


    // Legacy-safe user account helpers.
    // Missing fields fall back to the values used by older CS Master profiles.
    function userSchoolId(data) {
      return data.get("schoolId", "");
    }

    function userAccountType(data) {
      return data.get("accountType", "individual");
    }

    function userPersonalPlan(data) {
      return data.get("personalPlan", "free");
    }

    function userEffectivePlan(data) {
      return data.get("plan", userPersonalPlan(data));
    }

    function activeMembershipAfter(schoolId, userId) {
      return schoolId is string &&
        schoolId != "" &&
        existsAfter(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/schools/$(schoolId)/members/$(userId)
        ) &&
        getAfter(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/schools/$(schoolId)/members/$(userId)
        ).data.status == "active";
    }

    function validQualification(data) {
      return !("qualification" in data) ||
        data.qualification == null ||
        data.qualification == "GCSE" ||
        data.qualification == "A_LEVEL";
    }

    function validExamBoard(data) {
      return !("examBoard" in data) ||
        data.examBoard == null ||
        data.examBoard == "AQA" ||
        data.examBoard == "OCR" ||
        data.examBoard == "EDEXCEL";
    }

    function validOnboardingStatus(data) {
      return !("onboardingComplete" in data) ||
        data.onboardingComplete is bool;
    }

    function ownsClass(classId) {
      return isTeacher() &&
        exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/classes/$(classId)
        ) &&
        get(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/classes/$(classId)
        ).data.teacherId == currentUserId();
    }

    function belongsToClass(classId) {
      return signedIn() &&
        exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/classes/$(classId)
        ) &&
        currentUserId() in get(

        ).data.studentIds;
    }

    function assignmentExists(assignmentId) {
      return exists(
        /databases/$(database)/documents/assignments/$(assignmentId)
      );
    }

    function assignmentData(assignmentId) {
      return get(
        /databases/$(database)/documents/assignments/$(assignmentId)
      ).data;
    }

    function isTeacherForClassAssignment(assignmentId) {
      return signedIn() &&
        exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/classAssignments/$(assignmentId)
        ) &&
        (
          get(
            /databases/$(database)/documents/classAssignments/$(assignmentId)
          ).data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        );
    }

    function isStudentForClassAssignment(assignmentId) {
      return signedIn() &&
        assignmentId is string &&
        exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/classAssignments/$(assignmentId)
        ) &&
        currentUserId() in get(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/classAssignments/$(assignmentId)
        ).data.studentIds;
    }


    function examAssignmentExists(assignmentId) {
      return exists(
        /databases/$(database)/documents/examAssignments/$(assignmentId)
      );
    }

    function examAssignmentData(assignmentId) {
      return get(
        /databases/$(database)/documents/examAssignments/$(assignmentId)
      ).data;
    }

    function isStudentForExamAssignment(assignmentId) {
      return signedIn() &&
        examAssignmentExists(assignmentId) &&
        currentUserId() in
          examAssignmentData(assignmentId).studentIds;
    }
    
    
    
    match /studentTargets/{studentId} {
  function signedInForTarget() {
    return request.auth != null;
  }

  function isTargetStudent() {
    return signedInForTarget() && request.auth.uid == studentId;
  }

  function isTargetAdmin() {
    return signedInForTarget()
      && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(request.auth.uid)).data.role == "admin";
  }

  function teacherOwnsTargetClass(classId) {
    return signedInForTarget()
      && classId is string
      && exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/classes/$(classId))
      && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/classes/$(classId)).data.teacherId == request.auth.uid
      && studentId in get(/databases/$(database)/documents/classes/$(classId)).data.studentIds;
  }

  allow read: if isTargetStudent()
    || isTargetAdmin()
    || (
      resource.data.teacherId == request.auth.uid
      && teacherOwnsTargetClass(resource.data.classId)
    );

  allow create: if isTargetAdmin()
    || (
      request.resource.data.studentId == studentId
      && request.resource.data.teacherId == request.auth.uid
      && teacherOwnsTargetClass(request.resource.data.classId)
    );

  allow update: if isTargetAdmin()
    || (
      resource.data.studentId == studentId
      && request.resource.data.studentId == studentId
      && request.resource.data.teacherId == request.auth.uid
      && teacherOwnsTargetClass(request.resource.data.classId)
    );

  allow delete: if isTargetAdmin()
    || (
      resource.data.teacherId == request.auth.uid
      && teacherOwnsTargetClass(resource.data.classId)
    );
}

    // Users
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

  match /users/{userId} {

  allow get: if signedIn() &&
    (
      currentUserId() == userId ||
      isAdmin() ||

      )
    );

        currentUserHasSchool() &&
        resource.data.schoolId == currentSchoolId()
      )
    );

  /*
   * User profiles are created exclusively by trusted

  allow create: if false;

  /*

   * This version is intentionally legacy-safe:
   * old accounts that pre-date schoolId/accountType/personalPlan
   * are interpreted as:
   *
   *   schoolId     = ""
   *   accountType  = "individual"
   *   personalPlan = "free"
   *
   * That lets an authenticated teacher move into a school account
   * only when the matching active school membership exists after
   * the same atomic write.
   */
   /*
 * Legacy approved teacher -> school account migration.
 *
 * Older development teacher accounts can pre-date schoolId,
 * accountType and plan fields. This permits only the one-time
 * transition into an active school membership created in the
 * same atomic batch.
 */
allow update: if signedIn() &&
  currentUserId() == userId &&

  (
    resource.data.role == "teacher" ||
    resource.data.role == "admin"
  ) &&

  request.resource.data.role == resource.data.role &&
  request.resource.data.uid == currentUserId() &&
  request.resource.data.email == resource.data.email &&

  (
    !("schoolId" in resource.data) ||
    resource.data.schoolId == null ||
    resource.data.schoolId == ""
  ) &&

  request.resource.data.schoolId is string &&
  request.resource.data.schoolId != "" &&

  request.resource.data.accountType == "school" &&
  request.resource.data.plan == "school" &&

  /*
   * SECURITY:
   * School migration must not be usable to upgrade the user's
   * personal subscription. Billing-owned personalPlan remains
   * unchanged (legacy missing values resolve to "free").
   */
  userPersonalPlan(request.resource.data) ==
    userPersonalPlan(resource.data) &&

  activeMembershipAfter(
    request.resource.data.schoolId,
    currentUserId()
  ) &&

  request.resource.data
    .diff(resource.data)
    .affectedKeys()
    .hasOnly([
      "uid",
      "schoolId",
      "accountType",
      "plan",
      "personalPlan",
      "updatedAt"
    ]);
    
  allow update: if signedIn() &&
    currentUserId() == userId &&
    request.resource.data.uid == currentUserId() &&
    request.resource.data.email == resource.data.email &&
    (
      (
        "role" in resource.data &&
        request.resource.data.role == resource.data.role
      ) ||
      (
        !("role" in resource.data) &&
        request.resource.data.role == "student"
      )
    ) &&
    (
      !("accountIntent" in request.resource.data) ||
      !("accountIntent" in resource.data) ||
      request.resource.data.accountIntent == resource.data.accountIntent ||
      request.resource.data.accountIntent == "student" ||
      request.resource.data.accountIntent == "teacher"
    ) &&
    (
      !("teacherAccessStatus" in request.resource.data) ||
      !("teacherAccessStatus" in resource.data) ||
      request.resource.data.teacherAccessStatus ==
        resource.data.teacherAccessStatus ||
      request.resource.data.teacherAccessStatus == "not_submitted" ||
      request.resource.data.teacherAccessStatus == "pending"
    ) &&
    validQualification(request.resource.data) &&
    validExamBoard(request.resource.data) &&
    validOnboardingStatus(request.resource.data) &&
    validAccountType(request.resource.data) &&
    validPersonalPlan(request.resource.data) &&
    validEffectivePlan(request.resource.data) &&
    validSchoolIdField(request.resource.data) &&

    /*
     * SECURITY:
     * personalPlan is billing/server controlled.
     *
     * A client must never be able to turn "free" into "premium"
     * by writing its own users/{uid} document. The helper is
     * legacy-safe, so a missing old value is treated as "free".
     */
    userPersonalPlan(request.resource.data) ==
      userPersonalPlan(resource.data) &&

    request.resource.data
      .diff(resource.data)
      .affectedKeys()
      .hasOnly([
        "uid",
        "name",
        "email",
        "role",
        "accountIntent",
        "teacherAccessStatus",
        "accountType",
        "plan",
        "personalPlan",
        "schoolId",
        "currentCourse",
        "qualification",
        "examBoard",
        "onboardingComplete",
        "xp",
        "streak",
        "badges",
        "completedLessons",
        "completedTopics",
        "completedUnits",
        "completedPapers",
        "classIds",
        "updatedAt"
      ]) &&
    (
      /*
       * Normal update while staying in the same tenant/account state.
       */
      (
        userSchoolId(request.resource.data) ==
          userSchoolId(resource.data) &&
        userAccountType(request.resource.data) ==
          userAccountType(resource.data) &&

        /*
         * SECURITY:
         * Normal profile edits cannot change the effective plan.
         * Plan changes are reserved for trusted billing/server flows.
         * The explicit join/leave-school branches below are the only
         * client-side tenant transitions that may change plan between
         * personal and school states.
         */
        userEffectivePlan(request.resource.data) ==
          userEffectivePlan(resource.data)
      ) ||

      /*
       * Join/create a school.
       *
       * The resulting membership must already exist as ACTIVE
       * after this same atomic write.
       */
      (
        userSchoolId(request.resource.data) != "" &&
        userAccountType(request.resource.data) == "school" &&
        userEffectivePlan(request.resource.data) == "school" &&
        activeMembershipAfter(
          userSchoolId(request.resource.data),
          currentUserId()
        )
      ) ||

      /*
       * Leave a school.
       *
       * The previous membership must become FORMER in the
       * same atomic operation.
       */
      (
        userSchoolId(request.resource.data) == "" &&
        userAccountType(request.resource.data) == "individual" &&
        userEffectivePlan(request.resource.data) ==
          userPersonalPlan(request.resource.data) &&
        userSchoolId(resource.data) != "" &&
        existsAfter(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/schools/$(userSchoolId(resource.data))/members/$(currentUserId())
        ) &&
        getAfter(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/schools/$(userSchoolId(resource.data))/members/$(currentUserId())
        ).data.status == "former"
      )
    );


  /*
   * Teacher may only maintain classIds on a student
   * inside the same school.
   */
  allow update: if isTeacher() &&
    resource.data.role == "student" &&
    request.resource.data.role == resource.data.role &&
    (
      isAdmin() ||
      sameSchoolUser(userId)
    ) &&
    request.resource.data
      .diff(resource.data)
      .affectedKeys()
      .hasOnly([
        "classIds",
        "updatedAt"
      ]);

  allow delete: if isAdmin();
}

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Classes
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    match /classes/{classId} {

      allow get, list: if signedIn() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
          currentUserId() in resource.data.studentIds ||
          isAdmin()
        );

      allow create: if isTeacher() &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() &&
        request.resource.data.studentIds is list &&
        request.resource.data.assignmentIds is list &&
        (
          isAdmin() ||
          (
            currentUserHasSchool() &&
            request.resource.data.schoolId == currentSchoolId()
          )
        );

      allow update: if isTeacher() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        ) &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId == resource.data.teacherId &&
        (
          isAdmin() ||
          (
            (
              "schoolId" in resource.data &&
              request.resource.data.schoolId == resource.data.schoolId
            ) ||
            (
              !("schoolId" in resource.data) &&
              currentUserHasSchool() &&
              request.resource.data.schoolId == currentSchoolId()
            )
          )
        );

      allow delete: if isTeacher() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        );
    }


    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Existing quiz/test assignments
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    match /assignments/{assignmentId} {

      allow get: if signedIn() &&
  (
    resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
    currentUserId() in resource.data.get("studentIds", []) ||
    belongsToClass(resource.data.classId) ||
    isAdmin()
  );

allow list: if signedIn() &&
  (
    resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
    currentUserId() in resource.data.get("studentIds", []) ||
    isAdmin()
  );

      allow create: if isTeacher() &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() &&
        request.resource.data.classId is string &&
        ownsClass(request.resource.data.classId) &&
        request.resource.data.studentIds is list &&
        request.resource.data.studentIds.size() > 0 &&
        request.resource.data.studentIds.hasOnly(
          get(
            /databases/$(database)/documents/classes/$(request.resource.data.classId)
          ).data.studentIds
        ) &&
        request.resource.data.status == "active";

      allow update: if isTeacher() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        ) &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId == resource.data.teacherId &&
        request.resource.data.classId == resource.data.classId &&
        request.resource.data.type == resource.data.type &&
        request.resource.data.resourceId == resource.data.resourceId &&
        request.resource.data.get("studentIds", []) ==
          resource.data.get("studentIds", []);

      allow delete: if isTeacher() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        );
    }


    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Teacher resource class assignments
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    match /classAssignments/{assignmentId} {

      /*
       * Teachers may read their own assignments.
       * Enrolled students may read assignments containing their UID.
       * Admins may read all assignments.
       */
      allow get, list: if signedIn() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
          currentUserId() in resource.data.studentIds ||
          isAdmin()
        );

      allow create: if isTeacher() &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() &&
        request.resource.data.classId is string &&
        ownsClass(request.resource.data.classId) &&
        request.resource.data.studentIds is list &&
        request.resource.data.studentIds.size() > 0 &&
        request.resource.data.studentIds.hasOnly(
          get(
            /databases/$(database)/documents/classes/$(request.resource.data.classId)
          ).data.studentIds
        ) &&
        request.resource.data.resourceId is string &&
        request.resource.data.resourceId != "" &&
        request.resource.data.resourceType is string &&
        request.resource.data.status == "active";

      /*
       * Teacher or admin management updates.
       */
      allow update: if isTeacher() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        ) &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId == resource.data.teacherId &&
        request.resource.data.classId == resource.data.classId &&
        request.resource.data.resourceId == resource.data.resourceId &&
        request.resource.data.resourceType == resource.data.resourceType &&
        request.resource.data.studentIds == resource.data.studentIds;

      /*
       * Students may only update the completion counter and timestamp.
       * They cannot edit the resource, class, teacher, due date,
       * instructions or student list.
       */
      allow update: if signedIn() &&
        currentUserId() in resource.data.studentIds &&
        request.resource.data
          .diff(resource.data)
          .affectedKeys()
          .hasOnly([
            "completedCount",
            "updatedAt"
          ]) &&
        request.resource.data.completedCount is int &&
        request.resource.data.completedCount >=
          resource.data.completedCount &&
        request.resource.data.completedCount <=
          resource.data.studentCount;

      allow delete: if isTeacher() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        );
    }


    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Individual student resource progress
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    match /assignmentProgress/{progressId} {

  /*
   * Students can read their own progress.
   * The teacher who owns the corresponding class assignment
   * can read the student's progress.
   * Admins can read all progress.
   *
   * A missing progress document may still be read directly by
   * its expected student because its document ID follows:
   * assignmentId_studentId
   */
  allow get: if signedIn() &&
    (
      /*
       * Existing progress document.
       */
      (
        resource != null &&
        (
          resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() ||
          isTeacherForClassAssignment(
            resource.data.assignmentId
          ) ||
          isAdmin()
        )
      ) ||

      /*
       * Allows the app to check a student's own missing document.
       */
      progressId.matches(
        "^.*_" + currentUserId() + "$"
      ) ||

      /*
       * A teacher-side analytics loader may directly check an expected
       * progress document before the student has created it. Returning
       * "not found" for a missing document does not expose student data.
       */
      (resource == null && isTeacher())
    );

  allow list: if signedIn() &&
    (
      resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() ||
      isTeacherForClassAssignment(
        resource.data.assignmentId
      ) ||
      isAdmin()
    );

  allow create: if signedIn() &&
    request.resource.data.studentId ==
      currentUserId() &&
    request.resource.data.assignmentId is string &&
    isStudentForClassAssignment(
      request.resource.data.assignmentId
    ) &&
    progressId.matches(
      "^.*_" + currentUserId() + "$"
    ) &&
    request.resource.data.status in [
      "not_started",
      "in_progress",
      "completed"
    ];

  allow update: if signedIn() &&
    resource.data.studentId ==
      currentUserId() &&
    request.resource.data.studentId ==
      resource.data.studentId &&
    request.resource.data.assignmentId ==
      resource.data.assignmentId &&
    isStudentForClassAssignment(
      resource.data.assignmentId
    ) &&
    request.resource.data.status in [
      "not_started",
      "in_progress",
      "completed"
    ] &&
    request.resource.data
      .diff(resource.data)
      .affectedKeys()
      .hasOnly([
        "status",
        "startedAt",
        "completedAt",
        "updatedAt"
      ]);
      
      /*
 * Programming-assignment evidence.
 *
 * Students may save programming evidence only to their own
 * assignmentProgress document, only for a real programming
 * assignment in which they are enrolled.
 *
 * Assignment identity, student identity, class/teacher ownership
 * and assignment configuration cannot be changed here.
 */
allow update: if signedIn() &&

  // This must remain the student's own progress document.
  resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() &&
  request.resource.data.studentId == resource.data.studentId &&
  request.resource.data.assignmentId == resource.data.assignmentId &&

  // The corresponding class assignment must exist.
  exists(
    /databases/$(database)/documents/classAssignments/$(resource.data.assignmentId)
  ) &&

  // It must specifically be a programming assignment.
  get(
    /databases/$(database)/documents/classAssignments/$(resource.data.assignmentId)
  ).data.resourceType == "programming-challenge" &&

  // The signed-in student must actually be enrolled in it.
  currentUserId() in get(
    /databases/$(database)/documents/classAssignments/$(resource.data.assignmentId)
  ).data.studentIds &&

  // The submitted challenge must be the exact challenge assigned.
  request.resource.data.programmingChallengeId ==
    get(
      /databases/$(database)/documents/classAssignments/$(resource.data.assignmentId)
    ).data.resourceId &&

  // Required programming values.
  request.resource.data.programmingCode is string &&
  request.resource.data.programmingAttempts is int &&
  request.resource.data.programmingAttempts >= 1 &&
  request.resource.data.programmingPassedCount is int &&
  request.resource.data.programmingPassedCount >= 0 &&
  request.resource.data.programmingTotalTests is int &&
  request.resource.data.programmingTotalTests >= 0 &&
  request.resource.data.programmingPassedCount <=
    request.resource.data.programmingTotalTests &&
  request.resource.data.programmingPercentage is int &&
  request.resource.data.programmingPercentage >= 0 &&
  request.resource.data.programmingPercentage <= 100 &&
  request.resource.data.programmingLastPassed is bool &&
  request.resource.data.programmingLastError is string &&
  request.resource.data.studentName is string &&

  // An attempt may increase by exactly one.
  (
    (
      !("programmingAttempts" in resource.data) &&
      request.resource.data.programmingAttempts == 1
    ) ||
    (
      "programmingAttempts" in resource.data &&
      request.resource.data.programmingAttempts ==
        resource.data.programmingAttempts + 1
    )
  ) &&

  // Nothing else can be modified by this programming-evidence write.
  request.resource.data
    .diff(resource.data)
    .affectedKeys()
    .hasOnly([
      "studentName",
      "programmingChallengeId",
      "programmingCode",
      "programmingAttempts",
      "programmingPassedCount",
      "programmingTotalTests",
      "programmingPercentage",
      "programmingLastPassed",
      "programmingLastError",
      "updatedAt"
    ]);

  allow delete: if false;
}


    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Assignment results
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    match /assignmentResults/{resultId} {

  /*
   * Students may read their own existing result.
   *
   * The result document ID uses:
   * assignmentId_studentId
   *
   * The suffix check also allows a student to perform a direct
   * get before the result exists. Firestore can then return
   * "document not found" and the app displays "Not started".
   *
   * Teachers may read results belonging to their assignments.
   * Admins may read all results.
   */
  allow get: if signedIn() &&
    (
      (
        resource != null &&
        (
          resource.data.studentId ==
            currentUserId() ||
          resource.data.teacherId ==
            currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        )
      ) ||

      resultId.matches(
        "^.*_" + currentUserId() + "$"
      ) ||

      /*
       * Teacher analytics may check an expected quiz result before it
       * exists. Permit only the missing-document lookup; existing result
       * documents remain protected by teacherId/studentId ownership above.
       */
      (resource == null && isTeacher())
    );

  /*
   * Queries remain restricted to the student, owning teacher
   * or an administrator.
   */
  allow list: if signedIn() &&
    (
      resource.data.studentId ==
        currentUserId() ||
      resource.data.teacherId ==
        currentUserId() ||
      isAdmin()
    );

  /*
   * Students may create only their own completed result.
   * Assignment, class and teacher values must match the
   * original quiz assignment document.
   */
  allow create: if signedIn() &&
    request.resource.data.studentId ==
      currentUserId() &&
    assignmentExists(
      request.resource.data.assignmentId
    ) &&
    request.resource.data.classId ==
      assignmentData(
        request.resource.data.assignmentId
      ).classId &&
    request.resource.data.teacherId ==
      assignmentData(
        request.resource.data.assignmentId
      ).teacherId &&
    request.resource.data.resourceId ==
      assignmentData(
        request.resource.data.assignmentId
      ).resourceId &&
    request.resource.data.assignmentType ==
      "quiz" &&
    belongsToClass(
      request.resource.data.classId
    ) &&
    request.resource.data.status ==
      "completed";

  /*
   * Students may update only their own result while preserving
   * assignment ownership and identity fields.
   */
  allow update: if signedIn() &&
    resource.data.studentId ==
      currentUserId() &&
    request.resource.data.studentId ==
      resource.data.studentId &&
    request.resource.data.assignmentId ==
      resource.data.assignmentId &&
    request.resource.data.classId ==
      resource.data.classId &&
    request.resource.data.teacherId ==
      resource.data.teacherId &&
    request.resource.data.resourceId ==
      resource.data.resourceId &&
    request.resource.data.assignmentType ==
      resource.data.assignmentType &&
    request.resource.data.status ==
      "completed" &&
    request.resource.data
      .diff(resource.data)
      .affectedKeys()
      .hasOnly([
        "score",
        "totalQuestions",
        "percentage",
        "earnedXP",
        "timeTakenSeconds",
        "status",
        "completedAt"
      ]);

  allow delete: if isTeacher() &&
    (
      resource.data.teacherId ==
        currentUserId() ||
      isAdmin()
    );
}

    // AI-generated quizzes

      /*
       * Generated quizzes may contain answer keys and explanations.
       * Students receive assigned AI quizzes only through the protected
       * /api/quiz/secure server route, so direct Firestore reads are
       * restricted to the owning teacher or an administrator.
       */
      allow get: if isTeacher() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        );
    }

        request.resource.data.uid ==

        );
    }

match /users/{userId}/programmingPracticeResults/{resultId} {
