    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Teacher access requests
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    match /teacherRequests/{requestId} {

  /*
   * A signed-in user may submit only a pending teacher request
   * belonging to their own Firebase UID.
   */
  allow create: if signedIn() &&
    request.resource.data.userId == currentUserId() &&
    request.resource.data.status == "pending" &&
    request.resource.data.name is string &&
    request.resource.data.email is string &&
    request.resource.data.schoolName is string &&
    request.resource.data.jobTitle is string &&
    request.resource.data.message is string;

  /*
   * Applicant may open their own request.
   * Admin may open any request.
   */
  allow get: if signedIn() &&
    (
      resource.data.userId == currentUserId() ||
      isAdmin()
    );

  /*
   * Applicants need this because teacherRequestService performs:
   *
   * where("userId", "==", currentUserId())
   *
   * Firestore treats that as a LIST/query operation.
   *
   * Rules still protect other applicants: the query must only
   * return documents whose userId matches the signed-in user.
   */
  allow list: if signedIn() &&
    (
      resource.data.userId == currentUserId() ||
      isAdmin()
    );

  /*
   * Applicants cannot approve, reject or modify requests.
   * Review remains administrator-only.
   */
  allow update, delete: if isAdmin();
}

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Teacher resource library
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    match /teacherResources/{resourceId} {

      allow create: if isTeacher() &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId ==
          currentUserId();

      /*
       * Teachers may query their own resource library.
       */
      allow list: if isTeacher() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        );

      /*
       * Teachers/admins may open managed resources.
       * Signed-in students may directly open published resources.
       */
      allow get: if signedIn() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId ==
            currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin() ||
          resource.data.status == "published"
        );

      allow update: if isTeacher() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId ==
            currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        ) &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId ==
          resource.data.teacherId;

      allow delete: if isTeacher() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId ==
            currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        );
    }



    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Exam-style question sets
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    match /examQuestionSets/{questionSetId} {

      /*
       * Teachers may create question sets only for themselves.
       */
      allow create: if isTeacher() &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId ==
          currentUserId();

      /*
       * Teachers may read only their own question sets.
       * Admins may read all question sets.
       */
      allow get, list: if isTeacher() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId ==
            currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        );

      /*
       * Teachers may update only their own question sets.
       * The teacherId must never be changed.
       */
      allow update: if isTeacher() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId ==
            currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        ) &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId ==
          resource.data.teacherId;

      /*
       * Teachers may delete only their own question sets.
       * Admins may delete any question set.
       */
      allow delete: if isTeacher() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId ==
            currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        );
    }



    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Written exam assignments
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    match /examAssignments/{assignmentId} {

      allow get, list: if signedIn() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
          currentUserId() in resource.data.studentIds ||
          isAdmin()
        );

      allow create: if isTeacher() &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() &&
        ownsClass(request.resource.data.classId) &&
        request.resource.data.studentIds is list &&
        request.resource.data.studentIds.size() > 0 &&
        request.resource.data.studentIds.hasOnly(
          get(
            /databases/$(database)/documents/classes/$(request.resource.data.classId)
          ).data.studentIds
        ) &&
        request.resource.data.questionSetSnapshot is map &&
        request.resource.data.status == "active";

      allow update: if isTeacher() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        ) &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId == resource.data.teacherId &&
        request.resource.data.classId == resource.data.classId &&
        request.resource.data.studentIds == resource.data.studentIds;

      allow update: if signedIn() &&
        currentUserId() in resource.data.studentIds &&
        request.resource.data
          .diff(resource.data)
          .affectedKeys()
          .hasOnly([
            "submittedCount",
            "updatedAt"
          ]) &&
        request.resource.data.submittedCount is int &&
        request.resource.data.submittedCount >=
          resource.data.submittedCount &&
        request.resource.data.submittedCount <=
          resource.data.studentIds.size();

      allow delete: if isTeacher() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        );
    }


    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Student written exam submissions
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    match /examSubmissions/{submissionId} {

      /*
       * Written exam submission document ID:
       * assignmentId_studentId
       *
       * Students can read their own submission.
       * The owning teacher and administrators can also read it.
       */
      allow get: if signedIn() &&
        (
          (
            resource != null &&
            (
              resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() ||
              resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
              isAdmin()
            )
          ) ||
          submissionId.matches(
            "^.*_" + currentUserId() + "$"
          ) ||
          (resource == null && isTeacher())
        );

      allow list: if signedIn() &&
        (
          resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() ||
          resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        );

      /*
       * A student may create only their own initial submission for an exam
       * assignment that is actually assigned to them.
       */
      allow create: if signedIn() &&
        request.resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() &&
        submissionId.matches(
          "^.*_" + currentUserId() + "$"
        ) &&
        request.resource.data.assignmentId is string &&
        isStudentForExamAssignment(
          request.resource.data.assignmentId
        ) &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId ==
          examAssignmentData(
            request.resource.data.assignmentId
          ).teacherId &&
        request.resource.data.classId ==
          examAssignmentData(
            request.resource.data.assignmentId
          ).classId &&
        request.resource.data.status == "in_progress" &&
        request.resource.data.answers is list &&
        request.resource.data.totalAvailableMarks is int &&
        request.resource.data.totalAvailableMarks > 0 &&
        request.resource.data.totalAwardedMarks == 0 &&
        request.resource.data.percentage == 0 &&
        request.resource.data.overallFeedback == "" &&
        request.resource.data.integrityIncidents is list &&
        request.resource.data.integrityIncidents.size() == 0 &&
        request.resource.data.integrityTerminated == false &&
        request.resource.data.integrityTerminationReason == "";

      /*
       * Student updates:
       * - autosave answers
       * - normal submission
       * - start integrity monitoring
       * - record fullscreen/page-visibility incidents
       * - track current question
       * - integrity termination + automatic submission
       *
       * Identity and teacher-marking fields remain protected.
       */
      allow update: if signedIn() &&
        resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() &&
        request.resource.data.studentId == resource.data.studentId &&
        request.resource.data.assignmentId == resource.data.assignmentId &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId == resource.data.teacherId &&
        request.resource.data.classId == resource.data.classId &&
        isStudentForExamAssignment(
          resource.data.assignmentId
        ) &&
        request.resource.data.status in [
          "in_progress",
          "submitted"
        ] &&
        request.resource.data
          .diff(resource.data)
          .affectedKeys()
          .hasOnly([
            "answers",
            "status",
            "submittedAt",
            "updatedAt",
            "integrityPolicySnapshot",
            "integrityIncidents",
            "integrityTerminated",
            "integrityTerminationReason",
            "integritySessionStartedAt",
            "integrityLastQuestionNumber"
          ]);

      /*
       * Teacher/admin marking updates.
       */
      allow update: if isTeacher() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        ) &&
        request.resource.data.studentId == resource.data.studentId &&
        request.resource.data.assignmentId == resource.data.assignmentId &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId == resource.data.teacherId &&
        request.resource.data.classId == resource.data.classId &&
        request.resource.data.status in [
          "marking",
          "marked"
        ] &&
        request.resource.data
          .diff(resource.data)
          .affectedKeys()
          .hasOnly([
            "answers",
            "overallFeedback",
            "totalAwardedMarks",
            "totalAvailableMarks",
            "percentage",
            "status",
            "markedAt",
            "updatedAt"
          ]);

      allow delete: if isTeacher() &&
        (
          resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() ||
          isAdmin()
        );
    }


match /interventions/{interventionId} {
  allow create: if isTeacher() &&
    request.resource.data.teacherId == request.auth.uid;

  allow get, list: if signedIn() &&
    (
      resource.data.teacherId == request.auth.uid ||
      resource.data.studentId == request.auth.uid ||
      isAdmin()
    );

  allow update: if signedIn() &&
    (
      (
        resource.data.teacherId == request.auth.uid &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId == resource.data.teacherId &&
        request.resource.data.studentId == resource.data.studentId
      ) ||
      (
        resource.data.studentId == request.auth.uid &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId == resource.data.teacherId &&
        request.resource.data.studentId == resource.data.studentId &&
        request.resource.data.diff(resource.data).affectedKeys().hasOnly([
          "steps", "status", "completedAt", "updatedAt"
        ])
      ) ||
      isAdmin()
    );

  allow delete: if isAdmin() ||
    (isTeacher() && resource.data.teacherId == request.auth.uid);
}


match /studentTutorConversations/{conversationId} {
  allow create: if signedIn() && request.resource.data.studentId == currentUserId();
  allow get, list: if signedIn() && (resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() || isAdmin());
  allow update: if signedIn() &&
    resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() &&
    request.resource.data.studentId == resource.data.studentId &&
    request.resource.data.diff(resource.data).affectedKeys().hasOnly(["title", "messages", "updatedAt"]);
  allow delete: if signedIn() && (resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() || isAdmin());
  
  }



 match /lessonProgress/{progressId} {

  /*
   * Lesson-progress document IDs use:
   * {studentId}_{lessonId}
   */

  allow get: if signedIn() &&
    (
      (
        resource != null &&
        resource.data.studentId == currentUserId()
      ) ||
      progressId.matches(
        "^" + currentUserId() + "_.*$"
      ) ||
      isTeacher() ||
      isAdmin()
    );

  /*
   * Students may query only their own progress.
   * Teachers and administrators may query student progress.
   */
  allow list: if signedIn() &&
    (
      resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() ||
      isTeacher() ||
      isAdmin()
    );

  /*
   * Students may create only their own lesson-progress record.
   */
  allow create: if signedIn() &&
    request.resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() &&
    request.resource.data.lessonId is string &&
    request.resource.data.topicId is string &&
    request.resource.data.currentStepIndex is int &&
    request.resource.data.completedStepIds is list &&
    request.resource.data.practiceResponses is list &&
    request.resource.data.checkpointResponses is list &&
    request.resource.data.status in [
      "in_progress",
      "completed"
    ] &&
    progressId.matches(
      "^" + currentUserId() + "_.*$"
    );

  /*
   * Students may update the interactive state of only their
   * own progress record. Identity fields cannot be changed.
   */
  allow update: if signedIn() &&
    resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() &&
    request.resource.data.studentId ==
      resource.data.studentId &&
    request.resource.data.lessonId ==
      resource.data.lessonId &&
    request.resource.data.topicId ==
      resource.data.topicId &&
    progressId.matches(
      "^" + currentUserId() + "_.*$"
    ) &&
    request.resource.data.status in [
      "in_progress",
      "completed"
    ] &&
    request.resource.data
      .diff(resource.data)
      .affectedKeys()
      .hasOnly([
        "currentStepIndex",
        "completedStepIds",
        "practiceResponses",
        "checkpointResponses",
        "examResponse",
        "examMarking",
        "reflection",
        "audioEnabled",
        "audioRate",
        "selectedVoiceName",
        "practiceAccuracy",
        "checkpointAccuracy",
        "examAccuracy",
        "overallAccuracy",
        "masteryImpact",
        "reviewAt",
        "status",
        "startedAt",
        "updatedAt",
        "completedAt"
      ]);

  allow delete: if signedIn() &&
    (
      resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() ||
      isAdmin()
    );
}

    match /examTrainerAttempts/{attemptId} {
  /*
   * Exam Trainer is student self-practice rather than a teacher-controlled
   * formal examination. Even so, attempt identity and the selected question
   * set must be immutable once the attempt is created.
   */
  allow create: if signedIn() &&
    request.resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() &&
    attemptId.matches("^" + currentUserId() + "_[0-9]+$") &&
    request.resource.data.status == "in_progress" &&
    request.resource.data.report == null &&
    request.resource.data.questions is list &&
    request.resource.data.answers is list &&
    request.resource.data.currentQuestionIndex is int &&
    request.resource.data.durationSeconds is int &&
    request.resource.data.secondsRemaining is int;

  allow get, list: if signedIn() &&
    resource.data.studentId == currentUserId();

  /*
   * Only a live attempt may mutate. Questions, student identity, selected
   * filters, original duration and startedAt are intentionally excluded.
   */
  allow update: if signedIn() &&
    resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() &&
    resource.data.status == "in_progress" &&
    request.resource.data.studentId == resource.data.studentId &&
    request.resource.data.status in [
      "in_progress",
      "submitted",
      "abandoned"
    ] &&
    request.resource.data.currentQuestionIndex is int &&
    request.resource.data.currentQuestionIndex >= 0 &&
    request.resource.data.secondsRemaining is int &&
    request.resource.data.secondsRemaining >= 0 &&
    request.resource.data.secondsRemaining <= resource.data.durationSeconds &&
    request.resource.data
      .diff(resource.data)
      .affectedKeys()
      .hasOnly([
        "answers",
        "currentQuestionIndex",
        "secondsRemaining",
        "status",
        "report",
        "submittedAt",
        "updatedAt"
      ]) &&
    (
      (
        request.resource.data.status == "in_progress" &&
        request.resource.data.report == resource.data.report &&
        request.resource.data.submittedAt == resource.data.submittedAt
      ) ||
      (
        request.resource.data.status == "abandoned" &&
        request.resource.data.report == resource.data.report &&
        request.resource.data.submittedAt == resource.data.submittedAt
      ) ||
      (
        request.resource.data.status == "submitted" &&
        request.resource.data.report is map
      )
    );

  allow delete: if false;
}


match /users/{userId}/examTrainerResults/{resultId} {
  allow read: if signedIn() &&
    currentUserId() == userId;

  /*
   * A summary must correspond to the student's submitted Exam Trainer attempt.
   * These records remain self-practice evidence and are not formal grades.
   */
  allow create, update: if signedIn() &&
    currentUserId() == userId &&
    resultId.matches("^" + userId + "_[0-9]+$") &&
    exists(
      /databases/$(database)/documents/examTrainerAttempts/$(resultId)
    ) &&
    get(
      /databases/$(database)/documents/examTrainerAttempts/$(resultId)
    ).data.studentId == userId &&
    get(
      /databases/$(database)/documents/examTrainerAttempts/$(resultId)
    ).data.status == "submitted";

  allow delete: if false;
}

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Schools / organisations
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    match /schools/{schoolId} {

      allow create: if isTeacher() &&
        request.resource.data.name is string &&
        request.resource.data.slug is string &&
        request.resource.data.status == "active" &&
        request.resource.data.ownerUserId == currentUserId() &&
        existsAfter(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/schools/$(schoolId)/members/$(currentUserId())
        ) &&
        getAfter(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/schools/$(schoolId)/members/$(currentUserId())
        ).data.role == "school_admin" &&
        getAfter(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/schools/$(schoolId)/members/$(currentUserId())
        ).data.status == "active" &&
        getAfter(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(currentUserId())
        ).data.schoolId == schoolId;

      allow get, list: if signedIn() &&
        (
          isAdmin() ||
          isSchoolMember(schoolId)
        );

      allow update: if isSchoolAdmin(schoolId) &&
        request.resource.data.ownerUserId == resource.data.ownerUserId &&
        request.resource.data.slug == resource.data.slug;

      allow delete: if isAdmin();

      match /members/{memberId} {

        allow get, list: if signedIn() &&
          (
            isAdmin() ||
            isSchoolMember(schoolId)
          );

        allow create: if signedIn() &&
          memberId == currentUserId() &&
          request.resource.data.userId == currentUserId() &&
          request.resource.data.schoolId == schoolId &&
          request.resource.data.role == "school_admin" &&
          request.resource.data.status == "active" &&
          existsAfter(
            /databases/$(database)/documents/schools/$(schoolId)
          ) &&
          getAfter(
            /databases/$(database)/documents/schools/$(schoolId)
          ).data.ownerUserId == currentUserId();

        allow create: if signedIn() &&
          memberId == currentUserId() &&
          request.resource.data.userId == currentUserId() &&
          request.resource.data.schoolId == schoolId &&
          request.resource.data.status == "active" &&
          request.resource.data.role in [
            "student",
            "teacher"
          ] &&
          request.resource.data.inviteId is string &&
          exists(
            /databases/$(database)/documents/schoolInvites/$(request.resource.data.inviteId)
          ) &&
          get(
            /databases/$(database)/documents/schoolInvites/$(request.resource.data.inviteId)
          ).data.schoolId == schoolId &&
          get(
            /databases/$(database)/documents/schoolInvites/$(request.resource.data.inviteId)
          ).data.role == request.resource.data.role &&
          get(
            /databases/$(database)/documents/schoolInvites/$(request.resource.data.inviteId)
          ).data.status == "active" &&
          getAfter(
            /databases/$(database)/documents/schoolInvites/$(request.resource.data.inviteId)
          ).data.status == "used" &&
          getAfter(
            /databases/$(database)/documents/schoolInvites/$(request.resource.data.inviteId)
          ).data.usedBy == currentUserId();

        allow create: if isSchoolAdmin(schoolId) &&
          request.resource.data.schoolId == schoolId &&
          request.resource.data.userId == memberId &&
          request.resource.data.status == "active" &&
          request.resource.data.role in [
            "student",
            "teacher",
            "school_admin"
          ];

        allow update: if isSchoolAdmin(schoolId) &&
          request.resource.data.schoolId == resource.data.schoolId &&
          request.resource.data.userId == resource.data.userId;

        allow update: if signedIn() &&
          memberId == currentUserId() &&
          resource.data.userId == currentUserId() &&
          request.resource.data.userId == resource.data.userId &&
          request.resource.data.schoolId == resource.data.schoolId &&
          request.resource.data.role == resource.data.role &&
          resource.data.status == "active" &&
          request.resource.data.status == "former";

        allow delete: if isAdmin();
      }

      match /settings/{settingId} {
        allow get, list: if isSchoolMember(schoolId);
        allow create, update: if isSchoolAdmin(schoolId);
        allow delete: if isAdmin();
      }

      match /auditLogs/{logId} {
        allow get, list: if isSchoolAdmin(schoolId);
        allow create, update, delete: if false;
      }
    }


    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // School invitations / join codes
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    match /schoolInvites/{inviteId} {

      allow create: if isSchoolStaff(request.resource.data.schoolId) &&
        request.resource.data.code == inviteId &&
        request.resource.data.schoolId is string &&
        request.resource.data.createdBy == currentUserId() &&
        request.resource.data.status == "active" &&
        request.resource.data.usedBy == "" &&
        request.resource.data.role in [
          "student",
          "teacher"
        ] &&
        (
          request.resource.data.role == "student" ||
          isSchoolAdmin(request.resource.data.schoolId)
        );

      allow get: if signedIn() &&
        (
          isAdmin() ||
          isSchoolStaff(resource.data.schoolId) ||
          resource.data.status == "active"
        );

      allow list: if false;

      allow update: if signedIn() &&
        resource.data.status == "active" &&
        request.resource.data.status == "used" &&
        request.resource.data.usedBy == currentUserId() &&
        request.resource.data.code == resource.data.code &&
        request.resource.data.schoolId == resource.data.schoolId &&
        request.resource.data.role == resource.data.role &&
        request.resource.data.createdBy == resource.data.createdBy &&
        request.resource.data.expiresAt == resource.data.expiresAt &&
        existsAfter(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/schools/$(resource.data.schoolId)/members/$(currentUserId())
        ) &&
        getAfter(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/schools/$(resource.data.schoolId)/members/$(currentUserId())
        ).data.inviteId == inviteId &&
        getAfter(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(currentUserId())
        ).data.schoolId == resource.data.schoolId;

      allow update: if isSchoolAdmin(resource.data.schoolId) &&
        resource.data.status == "active" &&
        request.resource.data.status == "revoked" &&
        request.resource.data.code == resource.data.code &&
        request.resource.data.schoolId == resource.data.schoolId &&
        request.resource.data.role == resource.data.role &&
        request.resource.data.createdBy == resource.data.createdBy &&
        request.resource.data.expiresAt == resource.data.expiresAt &&
        request.resource.data.usedBy == resource.data.usedBy;

      allow delete: if isAdmin();
    }


    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // School transfer requests - future phase
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    match /schoolTransferRequests/{transferId} {

      allow create: if signedIn() &&
        request.resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() &&
        request.resource.data.toSchoolId is string &&
        request.resource.data.toSchoolId != "" &&
        request.resource.data.status == "pending" &&
        schoolExists(request.resource.data.toSchoolId);

      allow get, list: if signedIn() &&
        (
          isAdmin() ||
          resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() ||
          isSchoolAdmin(resource.data.fromSchoolId) ||
          isSchoolAdmin(resource.data.toSchoolId)
        );

      allow update: if signedIn() &&
        (
          isAdmin() ||
          isSchoolAdmin(resource.data.toSchoolId) ||
          isSchoolAdmin(resource.data.fromSchoolId)
        ) &&
        request.resource.data.studentId == resource.data.studentId &&
        request.resource.data.fromSchoolId == resource.data.fromSchoolId &&
        request.resource.data.toSchoolId == resource.data.toSchoolId &&
        request.resource.data.status in [
          "pending",
          "approved",
          "rejected",
          "cancelled",
          "completed"
        ];

      allow delete: if isAdmin();
    }


    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Generated reports - future reporting phase
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    match /generatedReports/{reportId} {

      allow create: if isTeacher() &&
        currentUserHasSchool() &&
        request.resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() &&
        request.resource.data.schoolId == currentSchoolId();

      allow get, list: if signedIn() &&
        (
          isAdmin() ||
          (
            currentUserHasSchool() &&
            isSchoolStaff(resource.data.schoolId) &&
            resource.data.schoolId == currentSchoolId()
          ) ||
          resource.data.studentId == currentUserId()
        );

      allow update, delete: if isAdmin() ||
        (
          isTeacher() &&
          currentUserHasSchool() &&
          resource.data.teacherId == currentUserId() &&
          resource.data.schoolId == currentSchoolId()
        );
    }


    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Feedback reports
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Feedback is written and reviewed only through authenticated
    // server routes using the Admin SDK. Client-side Firestore access
    // is deliberately denied so reporter identity/status cannot be
    // forged or browsed by another user.
    match /feedbackReports/{reportId} {
      allow read, write: if false;
    }


    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // User notifications - future alerts phase
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    match /users/{userId}/notifications/{notificationId} {
      allow get, list: if signedIn() &&
        currentUserId() == userId;

      allow create, delete: if false;

      allow update: if signedIn() &&
        currentUserId() == userId &&
        request.resource.data
          .diff(resource.data)
          .affectedKeys()
          .hasOnly([
            "read",
            "readAt",
            "updatedAt"
          ]);
    }


    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Licensing / subscriptions / billing
    // Future Free -> Premium -> School phase
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    match /subscriptions/{userId} {
      allow get: if signedIn() &&
        (
          currentUserId() == userId ||
          isAdmin()
        );

      allow list: if isAdmin();

      allow create, update, delete: if false;
    }

    match /schoolLicences/{schoolId} {
      allow get: if signedIn() &&
        (
          isAdmin() ||
          isSchoolAdmin(schoolId)
        );

      allow list: if isAdmin();

      allow create, update, delete: if false;
    }

    match /billingEvents/{eventId} {
      allow get, list: if isAdmin();
      allow create, update, delete: if false;
    }


    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Deny collections not explicitly listed
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    match /{document=**} {
      allow read, write: if false;
    }
  }
}

/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */
const nextConfig = {
  poweredByHeader: false,

  async headers() {
    const securityHeaders = [
      { key: "X-Content-Type-Options", value: "nosniff" },
      { key: "X-Frame-Options", value: "DENY" },
      { key: "Referrer-Policy", value: "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" },
      {
        key: "Permissions-Policy",
        value:
          "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), browsing-topics=()",
      },
      {
        key: "Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy",
        value: "same-origin-allow-popups",
      },
    ];

    return [
      {
        source: "/:path*",
        headers: securityHeaders,
      },
      {
        source: "/api/:path*",
        headers: [
          { key: "Cache-Control", value: "private, no-store, max-age=0" },
          { key: "X-Content-Type-Options", value: "nosniff" },
        ],
      },
    ];
  },
};

module.exports = nextConfig;

# CS Master â€” Major Post-Hardening Test Matrix

Run this after extracting the hardening ZIP and passing the command-line verification.

## Command-line gate

From `C:\Users\cr7ri\cs-platform-clean`:

```powershell
npm run verify
```

If `npm run verify` stops at a step, run the failing command separately and record the exact error.

## A. Assignment Wizard â€” all resource types

Use one teacher test account and one known student test account.

### A1. Existing Lesson

- Assign one exact lesson to one individual student.
- Student sees only that assignment.
- Start opens the exact assigned lesson even if the student's normal curriculum differs.
- Complete the lesson.
- Assignment becomes Completed automatically.
- Teacher completion count updates.
- Review reopens the lesson without awarding duplicate completion/XP.

### A2. Existing Quiz

- Assign one built-in quiz to one student.
- Test Practice mode.
- Complete it and confirm score, percentage and XP.
- Review Quiz opens read-only review and creates no new attempt.
- Teacher markbook matches the student result.
- Close the assignment and confirm a completed student can still review it.
- Create a second fresh quiz assignment, close it before the student starts, and confirm it cannot start a new attempt.

### A3. AI Quiz

- Create/save an AI quiz as the teacher.
- Assign it through Assignment Wizard to one student.
- Confirm Step 4 shows the saved quiz metadata and delivery mode.
- Student opens the exact AI quiz through the protected quiz player.
- Complete it and confirm score/XP persistence.
- Review opens read-only mode and does not restart the timer or attempt.
- Confirm another student who was not selected cannot open the assignment by URL.

### A4. Exam Paper

- Assign one saved Question Bank paper to one student.
- Confirm title/topic/question count/marks on Step 4.
- Student enters Exam Mode and answers autosave.
- Test full-screen exit countdown and return before five seconds.
- Test a separate disposable attempt where the five-second countdown expires and auto-submission occurs.
- Submit normally on another attempt.
- Teacher sees Awaiting Marking.
- Teacher marks/finalises and student sees final result.

### A5. Teaching Resource

- Assign one published teaching resource to one student.
- Student opens the exact resource.
- Draft/archived resources must not be available to students.
- Student marks the assignment complete only after finishing the resource.
- Teacher completion count updates once only.
- Reopening the completed resource must not increment completion again.

### A6. Programming Challenge

- Assign one exact challenge to one student.
- Student opens the exact challenge.
- Submit a failing attempt; assignment remains In progress.
- Submit a passing attempt; assignment becomes Completed.
- Teacher programming results show attempts and percentage.
- Try another submission after completion; it must be rejected rather than adding another attempt.

## B. Recipient and tenancy regression

- Whole-class assignment reaches every currently enrolled student.
- Individual mode reaches only selected students.
- A student in the same class but not selected cannot open an individually targeted quiz.
- A teacher cannot assign into another teacher's class.
- Remove a student from a class before pressing final Assign; the assignment should reject stale recipients rather than silently targeting them.

## C. Student regression

- Login / logout.
- Forgot-password page opens.
- Dashboard loads XP, curriculum, badges and recommendations.
- Learn page respects selected qualification/exam board during normal browsing.
- Assigned lesson override still opens the teacher-assigned lesson.
- Quiz Centre normal browsing still respects the student's curriculum.
- Assignments page filters and counts remain correct.
- Adaptive Learning, Knowledge Map, Analytics, Revision Plan and Programming routes open without application errors.

## D. Teacher regression

- Teacher login and dashboard.
- Classes and student membership.
- Assignment Centre totals.
- Quiz markbook.
- Written Exam markbook.
- Programming assignment results.
- Analytics / individual student analytics.
- Interventions and intervention reassessment entry into Assignment Wizard.
- Content Hub / Resource Library.
- Reports.
- Pricing page from View school plans.

## E. Production/navigation regression

Run a production server:

```powershell
npm run build
npm start
```

Check:

- `/`
- `/login`
- `/forgot-password`
- `/pricing`
- `/dashboard`
- `/assignments`
- `/quiz`
- `/teacher`
- `/teacher/assignments`
- `/teacher/assignment-wizard`

Ignore only the already-isolated Chrome DevTools `VM... reportAllChanges / startTime` instrumentation error. Record any application error that points to CS Master source, `_next` application chunks, Firebase permissions, a missing route, or a failed network request.

## F. Firestore rules regression

After deploying the new rules to the correct Firebase project:

- Teacher can still create/read/update own assignments.
- Student can start/complete own resource assignment.
- Student cannot create progress for an assignment they did not receive.
- Teacher can read own generated AI quizzes.
- Student cannot directly read a generated quiz document from Firestore, while the protected assigned AI quiz still works through `/api/quiz/secure`.
- Exam assignment creation and student submission still work.

## Exit criteria

Hardening can be closed when:

- `npm run verify` passes.
- All six Assignment Wizard resource types pass end-to-end.
- No new permissions regressions are introduced after Firestore rules deployment.
- No genuine CS Master console/network errors remain in the production smoke test.
- Teacher/student results and completion counts agree across both sides.

## v1.1 Trust, Feedback & Class Lifecycle â€” targeted acceptance

Run after `npm run verify`; this supplements rather than repeats the already-passed v1.0 regression suite.

- Student: Notifications opens and reflects current outstanding assignments/due dates.
- Student/Teacher: Feedback page submits one test report successfully.
- Admin: Feedback & Issues shows the submitted report; priority/status/note update persists.
- Teacher: Manage Classes can archive a test class and restore it.
- Teacher: An empty test class can be permanently deleted and disappears after refresh.
- Teacher: Delete is blocked for a class containing students or assignment history; archive remains available.
- Public: Privacy page renders the retention, security and data-rights sections.
